dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's great. In a way, everyone who has pursued the "Lunar Leviathan" can be regarded as having their wishes fulfilled.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You see you see, hasn't Jiawei found a healthy wife?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nantuck also became a reputable author because of the book on the "Lunar Leviathan," although its contents are wrong.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Kujirai Momiji became the most well-known fisherwoman in Inazuma and did what her father could not — catching the "Lunar Leviathan."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #So Paimon feels, {NICKNAME}'s will come true too! Tee-hee!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What did Paimon wish for just now?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Can't say! Can't say! If Paimon says it out loud, it won't come true!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The "Lunar Leviathan" won't be that stingy.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmmm— Ok, listen carefully! Paimon will only say it once!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's wish is for your wish to come true.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I didn't hear you, what did you say?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph, Paimon isn't going to repeat herself! Paimon wants to get some candy~ Lalala~
